about: The introitus of the formulary “7th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: All you nations, clap your hands; shout to God with a voice of exultation. For the Lord is exalted and to be feared, a great King over all the earth. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. All you nations, clap your hands; shout to God with a voice of exultation.
